City Metro.q: A tourist asks how to get to Dubai Mall. You…
options: Tell them: Red Line to Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall, then the link bridge

City Metro.q: Someone is eating on the platform. You…
options: Politely remind them eating isn't allowed on the Metro

City Metro.q: The Gold Class carriage is for…
options: Passengers with a Gold Class fare

Gulf Hotels.q: A guest arrives at 6am; check-in is at 3pm. You…
options: Store their bags and offer the lounge, or early check-in if a room is ready

Gulf Hotels.q: A guest complains about noise. You…
options: Apologise and offer a quieter room

Dubai Police.q: Someone is suddenly sent a huge sum from a brand-new account. You…
